chunks: He said: Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Khalid al-Maraghi reported to me, saying: Abu Abdillah al-Asadi narrated to us, saying: Ja’far ibn Abdullah al-Alawi al-Muhammadi narrated to us, saying: Yahya ibn Hashim al-Simsar al-Ghassani narrated to us, saying: Abu al-Sabah Abd al-Ghafoor al-Wasiti narrated to us, from Abdullah ibn Muhammad al-Qurashi, from Abu Ali al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Rasibi, from al-Dahhak ibn Muzahim, from Ibn Abbas (may God have mercy on him) who said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and his family and grant them peace, said:

Whoever doubts the excellence of Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him, will be raised from his grave on the Day of Resurrection with a collar of fire around his neck, having three hundred prongs. On each prong there will be a Satan grimacing at his face and spitting upon him.

key_terms.الشاك: The doubter, one who harbors doubt
key_terms.طوق: Collar, ring worn around the neck
key_terms.يتفل: To spit upon (as an act of contempt)
key_terms.يكلح: To grimace, frown, bare the teeth menacingly

ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for doubting the excellence of Imam Ali according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) warns through Ibn Abbas that whoever doubts the merit of Imam Ali (AS) will face a terrifying punishment on the Day of Resurrection. The hadith is recorded in the Amali of Shaykh al-Mufid and underscores the severe spiritual consequences of denying the divinely appointed status and excellence of Imam Ali in Shia belief.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 3. He said: Abul Hasan ‘Ali ibn Khalid al-Maraghi reported to me from Abu Abdillah al-Asadi, who reported from Ja’far ibn Abdullah at Alawi al-Muhammadi; who reported from Yahya ibn Hashim al-Simsar al-Ghassani, who reported from Abu al-Sabah Abdul Ghafoor al-Wasiti, from Abdullah ibn Muhammad al-Qarshi, from Abu ‘Ali al-Hasan ibn ‘Ali al-Rasibi, from al-Dhahhak ibn Muzahim, from Ibn Abbas - may Allah bless him with mercy, who reported that: The Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny said: "

Whoever doubts the excellence of ‘Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him, will rise from his grave on the Day of Reckoning, with a collar of fire around his neck, having three hundred prongs. On each prong, there will be a Satan frowning upon him, spitting at his face."
